steps.en: Driver notices that reached the 3rd letter stage are picked for an electronic reminder
steps.id: Notice driver yang sudah sampai tahap surat ke-3 dipilih untuk reminder elektronik

steps.en: The driver's latest mobile number is checked against the government database
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru driver dicek ke database pemerintah
steps.why_en: The check exists but is switched off by configuration, so only the number already on file is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ada tapi dimatikan lewat konfigurasi, jadi hanya nomor yang sudah tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: The updated mobile number is saved to the driver's record
steps.id: Nomor mobile yang diperbarui disimpan ke data driver
steps.why_en: Saving only happens when the check runs, and that check is switched off.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan hanya terjadi saat pengecekan jalan, dan pengecekan itu sedang dimatikan.

steps.en: A reminder is prepared only when the driver has a valid mobile number
steps.id: Reminder disiapkan hanya bila driver punya nomor mobile yang valid
